title: Everyday Phrases — Using a Fitness Tracker
scene_zh: 健康手環 · 情境對話
title_quote: Is this the new fitness tracker?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】⌚ 實用「戴運動手環」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Using a Fitness Tracker
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「戴運動手環」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是健康手環：新買的運動手環：拆盒充電、連藍牙配對手機，設定身高體重與每日目標，看步數、心率與睡眠分數，換一條舒服的錶帶並設好提醒。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Using a Fitness Tracker' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). A new fitness tracker: charging it, pairing over Bluetooth, setting height, weight and a daily goal, then reading steps, heart rate and the sleep score. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the new fitness tracker?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I got it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open the box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'm opening it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's inside the small box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a band and charger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the power cable?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's under the little plastic tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it need a full charge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, charge it before you wear it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tʃɑrdʒ ɪt bɪˈfɔr ju wɛr ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I plug it in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the cable in the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the battery empty right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, so put it on the charger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst soʊ pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒər./
dialogue.zh: 快沒了，所以放上充電器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does charging take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About an hour, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wear it while charging?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's pair it with my phone.
dialogue.zh: 我們把它跟我的手機配對吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, turn on your bluetooth first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which app should I download?
dialogue.zh: 我該下載哪個應用程式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the small card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now what do I do?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the app and make an account.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ði æp ænd meɪk ən əˈkaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 打開應用程式，註冊一個帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wants my email and password.
dialogue.zh: 它要我的電子郵件和密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type them in and tap next.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why can't it find my device?
dialogue.zh: 它為什麼找不到我的裝置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe your bluetooth is still off.
dialogue.zh: 也許你的藍牙還是關著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen shows no connection.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try moving closer to your phone.
dialogue.zh: 試著靠近你的手機一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still nothing. What now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's restart the app together.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起重新啟動應用程式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It finally found the tracker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now tap the pair button.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在點配對按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The band is buzzing now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the pairing worked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I update the firmware?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it takes two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wrist feels a little warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal after a long charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything ready for tonight?
dialogue.zh: 今晚的東西都準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the tracker is all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows a green check.
dialogue.zh: 應用程式顯示綠色勾勾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that means we're done.
dialogue.zh: 很好，那表示我們完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's read the little manual.
dialogue.zh: 我們看一下那本小說明書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's short, maybe four pages.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else is in the box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a clip and a sticker.
dialogue.zh: 只有一個夾子和一張貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, my first tracker.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的第一個手環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll like it, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The band feels a bit tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can make it longer.
dialogue.zh: 那我們把表帶放長一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How loose should it be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One finger should fit under it.
dialogue.zh: 一根手指能塞進去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you fix the strap for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju fɪks ðə stræp fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我調一下表帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, hold your arm still.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks nice on my wrist.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the black one suits you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I charge it again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snap the charger on the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The battery is at half now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will last two more days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's connect it to the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My app is still searching for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ æp ɪz stɪl ˈsərtʃɪŋ fər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn your bluetooth on again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just turned it on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the app see it now?
dialogue.zh: 應用程式現在看得到它嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet. Give it a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I should restart my phone.
dialogue.zh: 也許我該重新開機手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That usually fixes the bluetooth problem.
dialogue.zh: 那通常能解決藍牙問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's connected. That was quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, restarting helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear it in the shower?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ wɛr ɪt ɪn ðə ˈʃaʊər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's safe in water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sleep with it on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, it tracks your sleep.
dialogue.zh: 要戴，它會記錄你的睡眠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it wake me at night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the screen stays dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's turn off the buzzer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I hate loud buzzing.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我討厭大聲震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen is too bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower it in the settings menu.
dialogue.zh: 在設定選單裡把它調低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the settings?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the little gear on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found the brightness bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it to the left side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock is showing wrong.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It follows the time on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈfɑloʊz ðə taɪm ɑn jʊr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它會跟著你手機的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the date right today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it updated by itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take it off at work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ɪt ɔf æt wɜrk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep it on all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friends wear theirs all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you should do the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The strap pulls my hair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear it a little higher then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is set up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we can relax tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今晚可以放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, where's the charger?
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，充電器在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in my bag, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I set up first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put in your height and weight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I type my height?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the profile button on top.
dialogue.zh: 點最上面的個人資料按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm one hundred sixty tall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now choose your weight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I use kilograms or pounds?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kilograms, since that's our habit.
dialogue.zh: 公斤，因為那是我們的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My weight is fifty five.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, now pick a daily goal.
dialogue.zh: 好，現在選一個每日目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many steps should I aim for?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni stɛps ʃʊd aɪ eɪm fɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight thousand is a good start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds like a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can change it anytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also set a sleep goal?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ sɛt ə slip ɡoʊl?/
dialogue.zh: 我也可以設定睡眠目標嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just put eight hours there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my age too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the heart data needs it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number goes in that box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your age, just thirty two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my profile is saved now.
dialogue.zh: 應用程式存好我的資料了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let's put it on your wrist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛts pʊt ɪt ɑn jʊr rɪst./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們把它戴到你手腕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which wrist feels better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your left one, away from your watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr lɛft wʌn əˈweɪ frəm jʊr wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 左手，離你的手錶遠一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says to wear it snug.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug, but not too tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it track my heart now?
dialogue.zh: 它現在會測我的心率嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look at the green light.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sensor light is glowing green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the sensor doing its job.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many steps do I have?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows two thousand already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was just from the morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So walk more after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we walk to the park?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let's get some fresh air.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，去呼吸點新鮮空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my band just froze.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我的手環剛剛卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the button for ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happens when I press.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the battery must be dead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I thought it was half full.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dropped fast in the cold.
dialogue.zh: 天氣冷的時候掉得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the walk is off today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can still walk without it.
dialogue.zh: 我們還是可以不戴它去走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then how do we count steps?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just carry your phone with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the phone counts them too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So tonight we compare both numbers.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚我們比較兩邊的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's charge it after dinner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, and we'll check again later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you bring your phone along?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it's counting in my pocket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our street looks so quiet tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們這條街今晚好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why I like evening walks.
dialogue.zh: 所以我才喜歡傍晚散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel tired today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but the air helps.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，但空氣讓我舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How was your sleep last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not great, I woke up twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the tracker can show why.
dialogue.zh: 也許手環可以顯示原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, we'll check the data.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we take the long way?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it adds more steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sky is turning orange.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's take a photo here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says four thousand steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's already half your goal.
dialogue.zh: 那已經是你目標的一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should do this every evening.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該每天傍晚都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's try it for a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you hungry after walking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bit, let's cook something simple.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，我們煮點簡單的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you cook noodles tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, with eggs and greens.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's charge the band at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should be full by bedtime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen is still blank.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it ten minutes on the charger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ɑn ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒər./
dialogue.zh: 讓它在充電器上放十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's waking up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, it only needed power.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our steps came back on screen.
dialogue.zh: 我們的步數回到螢幕上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the count is the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we set a sitting reminder?
dialogue.zh: 我們要設定久坐提醒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, for every hour at work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do you start work?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At nine, so remind me then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It can buzz very quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, my office is very quiet.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我辦公室很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your band charging now?
dialogue.zh: 你的手環現在在充電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, it's on the kitchen counter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did today feel easier than yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, walking really helps my mood.
dialogue.zh: 對，走路真的讓我心情變好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the sleep score tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I want to see mine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you wear it all night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the whole point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let's go to bed early.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, no phone in bed tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, see you in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt si ju ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, and don't check the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl ænd doʊnt tʃɛk ði æp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall we keep the same plan?
dialogue.zh: 我們要維持同樣的計畫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's a simple habit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, did you sleep well?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around eight hours straight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's look at the sleep score.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine says seventy eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's pretty good, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but I still feel tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the number feel wrong?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼這個數字感覺不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe deep sleep was too short.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I see deep sleep?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the sleep card and scroll down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə slip kɑrd ænd skroʊl daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 點睡眠卡片然後往下滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows only two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains why you're sleepy.
dialogue.zh: 這就說明你為什麼想睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My score is lower than yours.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you woke up feeling fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the strange part.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers don't tell the whole story.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the band track heart rate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even while you're asleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My resting heart rate looks high.
dialogue.zh: 我的靜止心率看起來偏高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe you drank coffee too late.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had a cup at nine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, try tea instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we see the heart chart?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以看心率圖表嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the line goes up and down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə laɪn ɡoʊz ʌp ænd daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It jumped during my dream.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dreams can do that to you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I worry about it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, small jumps are normal.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the app says I was restless.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði æp sɛz aɪ wʌz ˈrɛstləs./
dialogue.zh: 應用程式說我睡不安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did turn a lot last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd tɜrn ə lɑt læst naɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the room was too warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's open a window tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you trust these numbers?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Partly, they're just a guide.
dialogue.zh: 部分相信，它們只是參考。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My watch measures sleep too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then compare the two scores.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They don't match at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every device counts a bit differently.
dialogue.zh: 每台裝置計算方式都略有不同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So which number is real?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one that matches your feeling.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I felt fine this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then trust your own body first.
dialogue.zh: 那就先相信自己的身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's note how we feel daily.
dialogue.zh: 我們每天記下自己的感受吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, in the app notes.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，記在應用程式的備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a note button here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type one short sentence each night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight I'll write sleepy but happy.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我會寫又睏又開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a good way to end it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɡʊd weɪ tu ɛnd ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make breakfast now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eggs and toast sound perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How did you sleep last night?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better, almost seven hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your score go up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only from seventy eight to eighty one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli frəm ˈsɛvənti eɪt tu ˈeɪti wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 有，從七十八升到八十一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What changed in your routine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put my phone in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊt maɪ foʊn ɪn ðə drɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That probably helped a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I fell asleep much faster.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart rate looks calmer too.
dialogue.zh: 我的心率看起來也平靜多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less coffee really shows up there.
dialogue.zh: 少喝咖啡真的看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the tea idea actually worked.
dialogue.zh: 所以喝茶那招真的有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let's keep that habit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we compare both nights?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the app keeps both records.
dialogue.zh: 好，應用程式保留兩筆紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chart is easy to read.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap a bar to see the details.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ə bɑr tu si ðə ˈditeɪlz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine shows a long awake gap.
dialogue.zh: 我的顯示有一段很長的清醒空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was when the neighbor's dog barked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz wɛn ðə ˈneɪbərz dɔɡ bɑrkt./
dialogue.zh: 那是鄰居的狗在叫的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I remember waking up then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the data matched your memory.
dialogue.zh: 所以資料符合你的記憶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least that part was right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small details can still surprise you.
dialogue.zh: 小細節還是會讓你意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you check yours every morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just once, with my coffee.
dialogue.zh: 只看一次，配咖啡的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checking often can make me anxious.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then set a fixed time for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɛt ə fɪkst taɪm fər ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mornings only, that's the rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good rule, let's both follow it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your band buzzed during my meeting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn on silent mode for work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find silent mode?
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼找到靜音模式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In settings, under alerts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, and it's on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now your meetings will stay quiet.
dialogue.zh: 這樣開會就不會被打擾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it still count my steps?
dialogue.zh: 它還會計算我的步數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It still counts, silent mode hides alerts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪl kaʊnts ˈsaɪlənt moʊd haɪdz əˈlərts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My goal is eight thousand steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, let's hit it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We could walk after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's take the path by the river.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts teɪk ðə pæθ baɪ ðə ˈrɪvər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that path very long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About half an hour, maybe less.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, that fits my break.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，剛好配合我的休息時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's meet at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring water for the walk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already in my bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's see who walks more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always win these little games.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then today you might win.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll check the numbers tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's sync the band with the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɪŋk ðə bænd wɪð ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 我們把手環跟應用程式同步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the app and pull down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's uploading the new data.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that takes a few seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sync stopped at sixty percent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the app open and wait.
dialogue.zh: 讓應用程式開著等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it says sync complete.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, everything is up to date.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，全部都是最新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we change the strap now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the grey one looks nicer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I take this off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide the little button and pull.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It came off quite easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now click the grey one in.
dialogue.zh: 現在把灰色那條卡上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this strap fit my wrist?
dialogue.zh: 這條表帶合我的手腕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this strap has more holes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grey one feels softer.
dialogue.zh: 灰色這條摸起來比較軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soft straps are better for sleeping.
dialogue.zh: 軟的表帶比較適合睡覺戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set the sitting reminder.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it for every hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time should it start?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine in the morning works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And when should it stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop it at six in the evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ɪt æt sɪks ɪn ði ˈivnɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The reminder is saved now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, stand up when it buzzes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These straps come in three colors.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Black, grey, and light blue.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe blue for the weekend.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a fun little change.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check today's total steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is nine thousand two hundred.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is only eight thousand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You still passed your goal today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天還是達到目標了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The river walk really added steps.
dialogue.zh: 河邊那趟真的加了很多步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's do it again tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our sleep scores are close now.
dialogue.zh: 我們的睡眠分數現在很接近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, only three points apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both of us are improving.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small habits really add up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's write down tomorrow's plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk at noon, sleep before eleven.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we keep the same goal?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, eight thousand is comfortable.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your band needs a charge again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on the desk before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə dɛsk bɪˈfɔr bɛd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm happy with this little device.
dialogue.zh: 我對這個小裝置很滿意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, it changed our evenings.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，它改變了我們的傍晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's compare again next week.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, same time next Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 說定了，下週日同樣時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you feel after one week?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju fil ˈæftər wʌn wik?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, much lighter and happier.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，輕鬆很多也開心很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your numbers get better?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, my average sleep went up.
dialogue.zh: 有，我的平均睡眠增加了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine too, about forty minutes more.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，多了大約四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a big change for you.
dialogue.zh: 那對你來說是很大的改變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The evening walks made the difference.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And putting the phone away helped too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈpʊtɪŋ ðə foʊn əˈweɪ hɛlpt tu./
dialogue.zh: 還有把手機收起來也有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we raise the step goal?
dialogue.zh: 我們要把步數目標調高嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's keep it for one more week.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kip ɪt fər wʌn mɔr wik./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, slow is safer.
dialogue.zh: 說得也是，慢慢來比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and we won't lose motivation.
dialogue.zh: 對，而且我們不會失去動力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My resting heart rate dropped a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈrɛstɪŋ hɑrt reɪt drɑpt ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我的靜止心率降了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's quite encouraging to hear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still check yours at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju stɪl tʃɛk jʊrz æt naɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only in the morning now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your app keeps a weekly report.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's read it together on Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunday works, we're both free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can plan the next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn plæn ðə nɛkst wik./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就能規劃下一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The grey strap was a good choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡreɪ stræp wʌz ə ɡʊd tʃɔɪs./
dialogue.zh: 灰色表帶是不錯的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It never bothers me at night.
dialogue.zh: 晚上戴著完全不會幹擾我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same here, I forget I'm wearing it.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr aɪ fərˈɡɛt aɪm ˈwɛrɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我常忘記自己戴著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A tracker should feel invisible.
dialogue.zh: 手環就該讓人忘了它的存在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to try a new band?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, this one still works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True, it's only one week old.
dialogue.zh: 也是，它才用了一個星期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's keep our money for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What was the hardest part?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waking up early on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For me it was the sitting reminder.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər mi ɪt wʌz ðə ˈsɪtɪŋ rɪˈmaɪndər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It buzzes right when I'm busy.
dialogue.zh: 它總在我忙的時候震動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At least you stand up more.
dialogue.zh: 至少你站起來的次數變多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My back feels better already.
dialogue.zh: 我的背已經感覺好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we should stretch together.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes every evening, deal.
dialogue.zh: 每天晚上五分鐘，說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's put that in the notes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, and I set a reminder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This little habit feels permanent now.
dialogue.zh: 這個小習慣現在感覺會一直持續。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, let's not break it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight we can sleep early again.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們又可以早睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and leave the phone outside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The band is charged and ready.
dialogue.zh: 手環充好電也準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So are we, see you tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep well tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too, no checking the score.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time tomorrow morning?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, breakfast and the report.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, our week ended well.
dialogue.zh: 很好，我們這一週結束得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It really did, we should celebrate.

issues.note: 非 error 級：本輪唯一超 7 詞句（原「Do you want to try a new band?」）已壓成「Want to try a new band?」共 6 詞，機器 word_cap 訊號歸零；語意、語法、逐詞對齊皆無誤，母語者口語自然。
風格級重複：全篇「Let's …」約 32 次，其中約 19 句為句首（19/45/149/203/249/319/331/341/349/387 等）。它是「共同計畫」最自然的動詞，不算錯誤，但開頭變化度偏單一（已反映在本維 21/25）。
輕微指涉鬆動（非 error）：63-71 搜尋中的 app／藍牙屬 char_b（「My app is still searching for it.」「I just turned it on.」），但 71 由 char_a 說「Maybe I should restart my phone.」後即連線成功，手機歸屬可再明確；不影響理解。
輕微重複（非 error）：久坐提醒的設定情節（每小時、早上九點）在 181-184 與 319-324 各出現一次，相隔約 70 對、非連續打轉；第二處確實補上起訖時間與 325「The reminder is saved now.」，尚可視為「先討論、後完成」。
詞彙略高於 A2：firmware（37）、anxious（275）、motivation（361）、restless（229）、permanent（389）屬 B1 常見詞，情境中仍可推知，未達 error 級。

review.summary_zh: 獨立複核通過：固定事實全篇一致（160 公分＝104 行、55 公斤＝108 行、32 歲＝119 行、每日 8000 步＝111/286/333 行、睡眠分 78→81＝203/253 行，且 337 行「only three points apart」正好對上 81 與 78），成對邏輯無互換位、無原地打轉、無段間斷裂；唯一超 7 詞句已修短，機器訊號現為 0。僅餘句首重複（Let's）、一處手機指涉與久坐提醒情節重複等風格級觀察，皆已具名且非 error。IPA 一項依機器證據給分（SUSPECT 0、逐詞 token 對齊通過），未自行重驗。
